def factor_volume_return_dir_corr_robust_zvol_clipped(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and clipped robust z-scored volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_med = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).median()
    vol_abs_dev = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_med).abs()
    vol_mad = vol_abs_dev.rolling(20, min_periods=5).median()
    vol_dev = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_med) / (1.4826 * vol_mad).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_dev_clipped = vol_dev.clip(lower=-3.0, upper=3.0)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev_clipped)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_robust_zvol_clipped"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_robust_zvol_clipped"]
description: Preserves the parent's core directional volume-return coherence mechanism: rolling correlation between signed daily returns and volume surprise. The mutation replaces the mean/std volume z-score with a robust z-score using rolling median and median absolute deviation (MAD), then clips at +/-3. This reduces the influence of extreme volume days on the correlation more effectively than standard z-score clipping, targeting a higher Pearson IC while retaining the parent's strong RankICIR and long-short payoff stability. Parent strength target: high RankICIR=0.4609 and long_short_sharpe=6.216.
